claim: Structured prompts (explicit instructions, constraints, format) reduce ambiguity and improve adherence for agentic coding workflows.
Instructions-first + clear delimiters improve reliability; prompting guides recommend separating instructions from context.
Even with checklists/structured prompts, errors persist; therefore prompts must be paired with verification/harnesses.
Execution-based evaluation is a stronger correctness signal than narrative compliance (tests/harness validate patches).
Repo-resident rules improve repeatability and reduce reliance on ephemeral conversation state.
